fact: Burundi's National Assembly unanimously adopted a bill governing the collection and processing of personal data across public and private sectors on 15 January 2026; the document does not report promulgation.
The adopted law creates an independent administrative data-protection authority responsible for enforcement; the document does not say it has been constituted.
Burundi's National Assembly met on 15 January 2026 to examine and approve a new bill on personal data protection, structured in eight chapters; the document does not report promulgation.
The law establishes an independent administrative authority to oversee personal data protection, and a dedicated body to implement and monitor data protection regimes; no appointment is reported.
